numbered_steps.action_paraphrase: Open List Files and confirm current directory.
Select the prior PARK file and retrieve its copy.
Position on the first old date numeral.
Enable Typeover with Insert.
Replace the old three dates with the prescribed new numerals and punctuation.
Disable Typeover and restore insertion.
Position anywhere inside the attendance sentence.
Open Move with Ctrl-F4.
Select Sentence.
Choose Move and retain the removed sentence.
Position at the start of the following paragraph.
Insert the retained sentence with Enter.
Use Home twice then Up to reach the document start.
Open Format.
Choose Line.
Choose Margins.
Set left and right margins to2in with separate confirmations.
Exit to the letter and move Down to reformat.
Return to the beginning and enable Reveal Codes.
Disable Reveal Codes.
Use Home three times then Up to reach the beginning in this context.
Open Format then Page.
Enable vertical page centering and exit to the letter.
Open Print.
Choose View Document then Full Page.
Choose100percent view.
Choose200percent and pan with arrow keys.
Exit preview to editing.
Open Print again.
Print the full document.
Open List Files while retaining the edited letter.
Select PARK and Look at its unchanged disk contents.
Exit Look then the list to return to the edited letter.
Exit and consent to saving the edited copy.
Confirm the existing PARK name.
Confirm replacement then decline application exit.
Open List Files again.
Select PARK and invoke Look with Enter.
Exit Look and the list.
Open List Files from a clear screen.
Select and retrieve the prior MEMO template.
Position on the To label and use End.
Type the prescribed recipient group.
Position at the start of the From label.
Enable Reveal Codes.
If necessary move Right into the Bold pair.
Move Right onto the Tab code.
Move Right past that Tab code.
Confirm position after Tab and type the sender.
Use End on the Subject line.
Type the prescribed subject.
Position on the subject-line Tab owner.
Delete that Tab and insert a new Tab.
Disable Reveal Codes.
Use PageDown to reach the end of this short form.
Type the prescribed two-paragraph memo message.
Position on the initial letter of the specified word.
Enable Underline and insert the modifier.
Disable Underline then insert the following space.
Use Home twice then Up to reach the document start.
Open Format then Line.
Choose Tab Set.
Use Home then Left to reach the ruler beginning.
Clear preset stops with Ctrl-End.
Set a relative left Tab at1.5in and confirm.
Exit twice to retain the setting and return to the memo.
Enable Reveal Codes and inspect the native Tab Set owner.
Disable Reveal Codes.
Open Print.
Print the full memo.
Exit and consent to saving.
Type the new PARKMEMO name and confirm.
Decline application exit and clear editing.
Open direct Retrieve using Shift-F10.
Retrieve the prior PARK second draft by name.
Enable Reveal Codes and position after the leading CenterPage/Margins owners.
Insert Date Text rather than Date Code.
Insert four hard returns after the date.
Move Up to the date beginning.
Disable Reveal Codes.
Use PageDown to reach the closing and insert two returns.
Type the prescribed typist initials.
Open Spell using Ctrl-F2.
Choose Document scope.
Check the letter using the described skip/correction choices.
Acknowledge the completion count and return to editing.
Print the full document.
Exit and consent to saving.
Confirm PARK then replacement, and decline application exit.
